title: University of California San Diego
description: UC San Diego's official brand guidelines define the core colours UC San Diego Navy (#182B49), UC San Diego Blue (#00629B), UC San Diego Yellow (#FFCD00) and UC San Diego Gold (#C69214), the accent colours Turquoise (#00C6D7), Magenta (#D462AD), Sand (#F5F0E6), Citron (#F3E500), Orange (#FC8900) and Green (#6E963B), and the neutrals Black (#000000), Cool Gray (#747678), Stone (#B6B1A9) and White (#FFFFFF).
